steps.text: A payment arrives through the Stripe API.
**[AI]** Feature values for the payment are computed in real time; a trained model estimates the probability it is fraudulent, 0 to 1.

c. matches a merchant's own rule → the merchant's chosen action; on the paid tier, a rule can send it to manual review.

steps.text: In one editor a developer has three ways to use Copilot, and chooses which at any moment.
Completions: the developer types → **[AI]** predicts the next text, shown dimmed → **[waits: developer]** takes it or keeps typing.
Chat: the developer asks → **[AI]** answers from project context — an explanation, a fix, tests, a comparison → **[waits: developer]** decides what to do with it.

Agent mode: the developer gives a larger task → **[AI]** breaks it into steps, inspects the project, edits multiple files, runs terminal commands, and responds to errors it encounters, in the local environment → **[waits: developer]** reviews the proposed changes and command output before accepting the result. Which actions prompt for permission along the way depends on the IDE and configuration.
